{{Top|leg}}
The '''Mark of Ragnos''' was a tag placed on the [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultists]] and [[Reborn]] led by [[Tavion Axmis|Tavion]], who was led by the dead [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Marka Ragnos|Ragnos]]. At the end of [[Jaden Korr|Jaden's]] training at the [[Jedi Praxeum|academy]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke]] mentions that a [[Sith cultist/Legends|cultist]] who had attacked Jaden earlier bore this mark. The appearance of it is unknown.
